cases.question: For an Ishven standard storage booking on 2055-09-21, which fee applies, and what approved fee applies from which later date? Explain why approval alone does not make the later fee current.
cases.admittedVisibleAnswer: For an Ishven standard storage booking on 2055-09-21, the fee that applies is the existing 15 CHF fee. The approved fee of 18 CHF applies from the activation date of 2055-10-07. Approval alone does not make the later fee current because the six-day storage limit is unchanged, but the fee only activates from the activation date in the meeting minutes. Staff must use the activation date, not the approval date, when deciding which fee applies to a booking. The trustees approved the replacement standard booking fee of 18 CHF on 2055-08-13, but it applies only from the activation date in the meeting minutes. The six-day storage limit is unchanged. This notice records an approved future fee and does not authorize collection before that date. The resolution dated 2055-08-13 sets 2055-10-07 as the activation date for the approved 18 CHF standard exhibit-storage fee. Until then the existing 15 CHF fee remains in force.
